verdict.rationale: Trello documents tracking task progress in a visual board layout. A community user confirms a status-style workflow of Idea, Doing and Done boards, which covers the status part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a priority attribute or a way to assign an owning team to an initiative. missing for 10: documented priority field or labels, documented owning-team assignment per card or initiative, initiative-level (not just task-level) tracking, in-depth first-party docs on these attributes.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Track progress of tasks in one convenient place with a visual layout that adds 'ta-da' to your to-do's.
Idea board => Doing board => Done board.
